assumptions: Statically analyzed supported CUDA subset; see workloads/TRANSFER_MODELS.md.
Unique byte footprints per kernel; byte_ranges in metadata are half-open intervals, not measured memory traffic.
Edges express overlapping-region RAW/WAR/WAW dependencies and conservative kernel input-to-output readiness, not stream execution order.
Stream/event ordering is checked for conflicting buffer accesses; metadata records operation ordering, not timing.
No compute time, cache effects, physical DRAM measurements, or internal shared-memory transfers.
Re-run after source changes; unsupported constructs are errors, not guessed dependencies.
Host input parsing/loading and CPU result selection use explicit, source-hash-checked summaries; they are not executed.
Device properties are configured assumptions, not measurements; bounded kernel address evaluation requires no GPU.
Device values remain unknown; data-dependent control/indexing and cross-thread read/write races are rejected.
Explicitly initialized or fixture-loaded integer index arrays are propagated through uploads; other device values remain unknown. This qualifies the unknown-index rejection above.
CPU-mediated dependencies are propagated conservatively per host buffer; CPU numerical values and latency are not simulated.
Host numeric array contents and random initialization remain unknown. Host allocation sizes and scalar control flow are evaluated; CPU numerical correctness is not validated.
Shared-array bounds are checked but contents remain unknown; shared transfers, initialization, races, and barrier correctness are not modeled. Global footprints assume valid kernel synchronization.
